meta.split_method: stratified: sorted by (kind, season, round_index, player), assigned A/B by alternating global index; one-sided rounds fixed by swapping two same-kind questions, or (for a singleton kind with no same-kind partner) by swapping with a question of another kind while keeping every kind with 2+ questions on both sides; each kind with 2+ questions and each round with 2+ questions appears in both sets
meta.date_fixes: v4 q13 round_date 20241201->20241030; S5 1-1 six questions round_date 20260101->event date each; v4 q32 (v3 q31) round_date 20250601->20240920; new SFTB 1-1 question round_date = event date 20260914 (see round_date_note on each fixed question).
meta.q57_dedup: no question removed: the duplicate (old83 q58, same Bloomberg 11-17 Aolani event as old83 q65) was already dropped in the v3 redesign; v5 keeps the single overseas_rental question.
meta.note: trace stays 558 moves: the nine S5 events are rewritten action texts on existing moves (with hp/gold set from the events), not new moves -- the converter requires exactly 18 moves per round. Baseline 48/88 is the 88-question reference, not re-run. A/B splits are re-derived, so v5 splits differ from v4 splits; compare scores on the full set.
